the_trade_off_made: We favored immediate business impact and security/legal compliance over fairness to free‑plan customers and monetary value. This sacrifices quicker service for paying customers, costing potential goodwill from high‑paying accounts.
hardest_call: Choosing between the security incident (NEW-00004) and the GDPR request (NEW-00002) was hardest; both have mandatory uplift rules and either could reasonably sit at position three.

how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.why_it_ranks_here: User impact and work blockage are the clearest signs of business harm for this batch
how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.what_it_gets_wrong: It can under‑weight legal deadlines that are critical regardless of user count

how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.why_it_ranks_here: Time left before promised resolution directly drives urgency
how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.what_it_gets_wrong: It ignores the scale of impact, so a far‑away deadline on a massive outage might be deprioritized

how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.why_it_ranks_here: Ensures free‑plan customers with real problems are not pushed to the bottom
how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.what_it_gets_wrong: May elevate low‑impact tickets above higher‑value ones

how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.why_it_ranks_here: Revenue is least relevant when critical functionality is broken
how_it_ranked_the_four_ways.what_it_gets_wrong: Could delay attention to high‑paying customers whose issues also affect revenue

why_the_winner_beat_the_runner_up: Damage outranked deadline because the tickets with the greatest user impact also happened to have the tightest time constraints, reinforcing the priority of impact over pure timing.

reasons_before_correction.NEW-00001: Critical lockout affecting thousands and blocking work with only 2.9 h left makes it top priority.
reasons_before_correction.NEW-00003: Payments failing blocks revenue for over a thousand users and is critical, though deadline is farther out.
reasons_before_correction.NEW-00004: Potential security breach triggers policy requiring at‑least top‑3 placement despite low monitored severity.
reasons_before_correction.NEW-00002: Legal GDPR deletion request must be handled within the statutory window, so it ranks high.
reasons_before_correction.NEW-00005: Dashboard showing stale data affects few users and is not blocked, so it stays last.
